static_checks.evidence: C<=2 enforced; shapes, batch count, bool validity, int64 indices, in-range valid indices and finite valid values checked. Zero conditions permitted.

Invalid indices replaced by zero before gather; invalid values zeroed before projection; invalid tokens zeroed and marked as key_padding_mask=True. Latent keys remain unmasked, avoiding all-masked attention for positive latent length.

All hidden pose channels zeroed before input projection and replaced by mask token; visible nonfinite values rejected. This removes hidden pose GT dependence and avoids 0*NaN input-projection gradient contamination in the intended finite-descriptor path. Explicit source_contact remains independently observable even on hidden joints; caller must not accidentally pass hidden contact labels as observed inputs.
NaN and Inf contacts are replaced with zero before con_emb; output including bias is multiplied by finite mask. This fixes Inf->floatmax overflow and masks unknown contact contribution.

Reference keys and shapes must exactly match hard-coded known old model schema before any allowed judge/semantic-projection exclusions. Empty or missing-key references now reject. Actual383-key checkpoint compatibility and numerical values were not executed here.

For previously read pre-norm residual EncBlock/CrossBlock implementation, zero attention output and FF output weights/biases make added blocks algebraically identity for finite activations. No numerical equality test executed.

Sparse-condition MLP and two missingness-bit projection are shared across joints/bodies. Whole model is correctly not claimed identical to reference because Qwen projection and new conditioning are new.

Uses inherited encode/FSQ, then shared topology-conditioned decoder; no body-specific branches introduced locally. Requires single_codebook=False, rot_only=False, use_sem=True and n_judges=0 for the promised pilot.

Returns inherited raw hpos tensor without FK or XYZ conversion. Old train_dual.py137-139 defines root_pos channels as height/forward-speed/side-speed; later449-451 supervise root channel0 height only. Trainer must treat this as auxiliary/root slots and use FK for position supervision, not generic per-joint Cartesian XYZ.

findings.title: Constrain inherited modes that conditional decoder does not implement
findings.trigger: Constructing with root_head=True, rot_head=angles, rot_only=True, vis_residual=True, or n_judges>0 remains accepted through **kwargs.
findings.impact: decode_conditional bypasses the corresponding parent branches: root-head output is never assigned, angle head returns9 raw values instead of converted6D, rot_only computes an untrained position path, visible residual is ignored. n_judges>0 also allocates per-body judge parameters even though local docstring claims none. These do not affect a caller that explicitly freezes the intended pilot flags.
findings.recommendation: Assert the supported pilot configuration in constructor (at least use_sem=True, n_judges=0, single_codebook=False, rot_only=False, rot_head=free, vis_residual=False, root_head=False), or implement the advertised alternatives. Explicit trainer configuration alone must be inspected before marking this resolved.
